ModMetaData.name: Grithe Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces VanillaExpanded.VGeneticsE's GR_ParagonRat art and label/description (primary look, south/east/north facings only - the dessicated-corpse texture stays on donor art) per the 2026-09-11 owner ruling on `art: "improve"` rows: non-SW names are free to be reimagined (general kind fixed, specific name/character not). GR_ParagonRat is reimagined as **Grithe**, a chitin-plated insectoid-rodent scavenger with oversized grasping forepaws - not a literal rat. Full regeneration, heavy black outline required.
defName is NOT renamed (this is a donor mod's def, not ours - a real rename would mean absorbing the def into our own mod wholesale, out of scope for an art-wiring pass). Instead: loose Textures/ at the same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/Paragon/Rat/GR_ParagonRat_<facing>) the donor uses, so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution, plus a small Patches/ pass renaming the label/description on both the ThingDef and the PawnKindDef so the in-game name reads as the new character.
